body:
## Change

F1. Apply existing unsupported ILLEGAL scope-bit check to published decks, matching draft validation. Release/legacy gameplay validation no longer accepts cards marked unusable in duel. Rules authority unchanged.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN covers normal-scope acceptance versus ILLEGAL rejection. Parent verified existing draft rule and published validator, reran 13 validation/resolver/YDK tests. Worker broader related: 23; boundaries: 52; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Local release-validator fixture, not live publication or engine duel. No schema/API/rules-policy change. Full repo/browser gates not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(decks): reject unusable cards at published-deck boundary
